tldr: Google just entered the AI music race with Lyria 3—free in Gemini app, creating 30-second tracks from text or media. This joins Suno, Udio, and ElevenLabs in a rapidly consolidating market. Warner & Universal have settled lawsuits with AI music companies, signing licensing deals—the new normal. Streaming platforms are fighting back with three-tier royalty systems that pay less for AI-generated content. For Musio, the opportunity is in AI-assisted production tools that enhance human creativity, not replace it. The VST/plugin market remains strong (Serum 2 leading), showing composers still value high-quality sample libraries.

research.title: Musio Pricing: Subscription & Perpetual Options
research.summary: Musio+ starts free with Essentials, expands to full library. Educational discount: $49/year. Perpetual license available at $149 (normally $199) for 2,000+ instruments. Monthly and annual subscription options.

research.title: Google Lyria 3 - AI Music in Gemini
research.summary: Google released Lyria 3, their most advanced music generation model, now available in the Gemini app. Users can create 30-second tracks using text prompts or upload photos/videos for AI to create matching music.

research.title: ElevenLabs Launches AI Music Platform
research.summary: ElevenLabs launches ElevenLabs Music, entering the AI music race with Suno and Udio, using artist-led releases like The Eleven Album to compete.

research.title: Warner Music Signs Deal with Suno
research.summary: Warner Music signs licensing deal with AI song generator Suno after settling copyright infringement lawsuit. First-of-its-kind deal in the industry.

research.title: Top AI Music Companies 2026
research.summary: Udio carving a different lane in 2026. Both Suno and Udio were sued by major music companies, now settling and entering partnerships.

research.title: 10 Best VST Plugins for 2026
research.summary: Must-have VST plugins: Serum 2 by Xfer Records (legendary wavetable synth), MOSAIQ, and emerging tools for music production.

research.title: Top 5 AI Music Generators 2026
research.summary: AI music generation branched into two directions: generative 'complete' song creators (Suno, Udio) and AI-assisted production tools.

research.title: AI Music Royalty Tiers
research.summary: Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon adopting AI detection systems with three-tier royalty structure: (1) fully human-made, (2) AI-assisted, (3) fully AI-generated (minimal/no rates)

research.title: Artists as Teammates with AI
research.summary: 2026: Lines blur between music, storytelling, and technology. AI becomes collaborative tool, not replacement. Short-form storytelling becomes core to A&R.
